wrap_zone_1.label: Left Hood Panel
wrap_zone_1.anchorDescription: The driver-side hood panel of the coffee kiosk, the sloped surface directly above the service counter.
wrap_zone_1.generativeFragment: Place the logo flat and centered across the driver-side hood panel in a landscape orientation, following the panel's slight forward slope so it reads clearly from the counter side of the truck.

wrap_zone_2.anchorDescription: The narrow trim strip running along the front edge of the driver-side service counter, just below the hood panel.
